name: Daily Supplier Reliability Scoring and Dynamic Buffer Stock Optimization

parameters.query: SELECT po.supplier_id, po.plant, po.storage_location, po.material_number, po.ordered_qty, po.received_qty, po.requested_date, po.actual_delivery_date, po.order_date FROM purchase_orders po WHERE po.order_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days' ORDER BY po.supplier_id, po.order_date

SELECT ro.material_number, ro.plant, ro.storage_location, ro.ordered_qty, ro.order_date, ro.reason FROM replacement_orders ro WHERE ro.order_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days' ORDER BY ro.material_number, ro.order_date
SELECT inv.material_number, inv.plant, inv.storage_location, inv.current_stock, inv.category, inv.last_updated FROM inventory inv ORDER BY inv.material_number

SELECT supplier_id, plant, storage_location, COUNT(*) as consecutive_weeks FROM supplier_scores WHERE supplier_score < 70 AND score_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '21 days' GROUP BY supplier_id, plant, storage_location, DATE_TRUNC('week', score_date) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT DATE_TRUNC('week', score_date)) >= 3
